blurb.text: A Portuguese regional wine area (Vinho Regional). Jaen is the most planted grape at 23 percent of vines, then Touriga Nacional at 21 percent and Tinta Roriz at 18, with Alfrocheiro, Encruzado and Baga also grown.

sources.name: Anderson, Nelgen and Puga, Database of Regional, National and Global Winegrape Bearing Areas by Variety, 2000 to 2023, University of Adelaide (CC BY 4.0)
